📊 Stock Market Update - 31 Jul 2026

**Key Takeaways:**

• **Risk vs. Reward**: Understand the difference between common and preferred stock, and how market capitalization affects risk and potential growth.
• **Diversify Your Portfolio**: Spread investments across asset classes, sectors, and market capitalizations to minimize risk.
• **Research Before Investing**: Understand a company's financials, industry trends, and competitive landscape.
• **Monitor and Adjust**: Regularly review your portfolio to ensure it remains aligned with your investment goals.

**Learn More**: Visit our website to learn about different types of stocks and how to create a diversified portfolio. 📈 https://www.broadfsc.com/different
